name: Critical Effects (DH2): Rending - Body
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-20 (p. 240). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: If the target wears no armour on this location, 1 level of Fatigue. If armoured, no effect.
1 level of Fatigue. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round.
Stunned for 1 round. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or suffer Blood Loss.
Stunned for 1 round and Blood Loss.
Blood Loss and [[1d10]] Toughness damage. Anyone moving through the pool of blood must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility test or fall Prone.
Knocked Prone, Blood Loss and [[1d10]] Toughness damage.

Blood Loss. Toughness permanently reduced by [[1d5]]. Until medical attention, at the end of each round in which he acted rather than holding the wound closed, roll [[1d10]]: on a 1 or 2 he takes a further [[2d10]] Rending damage.
Challenging (+0) Toughness test or die. On a success: Stunned for 1 round and Blood Loss. Toughness permanently reduced by [[1d10]].
As result 9. For the rest of the fight, anyone moving within 4 metres of the corpse must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility test or fall Prone.
